description: This file defines an enum VoiceOverlayTextFormatting containing static functions for computing text differences and creating attributed strings with formatting for overlay text in a voice interface.

methods.name: delta(after:committed:current:)
methods.description: Computes the delta between the committed and current strings, returning the substring of current after the length of committed if current starts with committed.

methods.name: makeAttributed(committed:volatile:isFinal:)
methods.description: Creates an NSAttributedString that combines committed and volatile text segments with appropriate attribution, adjusting color based on the isFinal flag.
